headline: Buzelis scores 24 as the Bulls hold on in Charlotte
dek: Matas Buzelis scored 24, and Josh Giddey had 12 points, 11 rebounds and 7 assists.
three: Matas Buzelis: 24 points, 8 of 9 at the line
His fourth 20-point game in his last six, on 8 of 15 shooting.
Bulls down 2 at the half, up 2 after three, then held on in a 34–34 fourth
Won it off the bench and with the extra pass
Bench points 42–22; assists 25–20. Chicago assisted on 25 of its 39 baskets.
top: off the bench, 3 of 4 from three
